title: ucwf-world
label: Bobby Linken

won.source: Wins the title from Johnny Johnson at Wrestle Insanity 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/wrestle-insanity-2003.html).

how: Wins the title off a distracted Johnny Johnson at Wrestle Insanity 2003. Lost at some unrecorded point before Resurrection, where Johnson is again the reigning champion.

title: ucwf-world
label: The Notorious Don Joe Giovanni

won.source: Wins the title from Johnny Johnson at Resurrection 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/resurrection-2003.html).

how: Wins the title off Johnny Johnson at Resurrection 2003; survives a 60-minute Hell In A Cell Ironman defense against Ace Of Spades at Fury 2003-06-20, three falls to two, before losing the title to the same man weeks later in a Breakout dome-cage match.

title: ucwf-world
label: Ace Of Spades

won.source: Wins the title from The Notorious Don Joe Giovanni in a Breakout dome-cage match (promotions/ucwf/archive/breakout-2003.html).

how: Wins the title in a Breakout dome-cage match, kicking The Notorious Don Joe Giovanni off a 20-foot ladder before pulling himself out through the roof hatch alone — weeks after surviving Giovanni's own 60-minute Ironman defense at Fury 2003-06-20 without winning it.

title: ucwf-world
label: Bobby Linken

won.source: Already UCWF World Champion by the held record's start.

how: Already champion entering Immortality 2002, where he retains the title in the second fall of the show's own Extreme/World Hell in a Cell over Brax and Blaze, and again over The Fox at Fury 2002-09-08. Lost at some unrecorded point before Wrestle Insanity, where Johnny Johnson is the reigning champion.

title: ucwf-world
label: Johnny Johnson
how: Loses the title to Bobby Linken at Wrestle Insanity 2003, rolled up while distracted by a fabricated in-arena news report naming him alongside a dying convicted murderer.

title: ucwf-world
label: Johnny Johnson
how: Loses the title to The Notorious Don Joe Giovanni at Resurrection 2003, a quick three-count by special guest referee Mumrat that Johnson protests the instant he comes to.

title: ucwf-universal
label: The Krazy Kid

won.source: Wins the title from CM2 at Fury 2002-09-08 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2002-09-08.html).

how: Wins the title from CM2 at Fury 2002-09-08 with the Krazy Cutter. Lost at some unrecorded point before Wrestle Insanity, where Mr. Wacko is the reigning champion.

title: ucwf-universal
label: “QBz Finest” Blaze

won.source: Wins the title from Mr. Wacko at Resurrection 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/resurrection-2003.html).

how: Wins the title from Mr. Wacko at Resurrection with the Special Delivery. Enters Breakout's own Six Pack Challenge still champion and loses the title there to The Fox.

title: ucwf-universal
label: The Fox

won.source: Wins the title in a Six Pack Challenge at Breakout 2003, pinning Jason Compton (promotions/ucwf/archive/breakout-2003.html).

how: Wins a six-man Six Pack Challenge at Breakout, pinning Jason Compton with a German suplex bridge — the last title change the surviving record shows for this belt.

title: ucwf-universal
label: Ace Of Spades

won.source: Already UCWF Universal Champion by the held record's start.

how: Already champion entering Immortality 2002, where his title defense against Jinx ends in a declared double-pin — no title change. Lost at some unrecorded point before Fury 2002-09-08, where CM2 is the outgoing champion.

title: ucwf-universal
label: CM2
how: Loses the title to The Krazy Kid at Fury 2002-09-08.

title: ucwf-universal
label: Mr. Wacko
how: Already champion entering Wrestle Insanity, where he retains in a three-way over Retchrobuter and “Genuine” Johnny Monroe. Loses the title to “QBz Finest” Blaze at Resurrection.

title: ucwf-tag-team
label: The Krazy-Wacko Connection

won.source: Wins the titles from Dark Carnival at Immortality 2002 (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html).

how: Wins the titles from Dark Carnival at Immortality 2002. Loses them by disqualification to The G's at Fury 2002-09-08, when Homefry passes Playa 69 a steel chair mid-match.

title: ucwf-tag-team
label: The G's

won.source: Wins the titles by disqualification over the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Fury 2002-09-08 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2002-09-08.html).

how: Wins the titles by disqualification at Fury 2002-09-08. Lost at some unrecorded point before Wrestle Insanity, where the Krazy-Wacko Connection is again the defending champion.

title: ucwf-tag-team
label: A.C.E.

won.source: Wins the titles from the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Wrestle Insanity 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/wrestle-insanity-2003.html).

how: Wins the titles from the Krazy-Wacko Connection at Wrestle Insanity. Lost at some unrecorded point before Resurrection, where the Krazy-Wacko Connection is again the defending champion.

title: ucwf-tag-team
label: Dark Carnival

won.source: Already UCWF Tag Team Champions by the held record's start.

how: Already champions entering Immortality 2002, where they lose the titles to the Krazy-Wacko Connection off a shooting star press.

title: ucwf-tag-team
label: The Krazy-Wacko Connection
how: Already champions again entering Wrestle Insanity, where they lose the titles to A.C.E., Ace Of Spades pinning The Krazy Kid with The Crossover.

title: ucwf-tag-team
label: The Krazy-Wacko Connection
how: Already champions again entering Resurrection, where they retain, “STILL” champions, over Italian Organized Crime — the last the surviving record shows of this belt.

title: ucwf-intercontinental
label: Scorpion

won.source: Wins the title from Crash Paradise at Immortality 2002 (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html).

how: Wins the title from Crash Paradise at Immortality 2002 and retains it over Big Poppa Pimp at Fury 2002-09-08 — Johnny Johnson steals the belt off him with a kendo stick afterward, an angle beat the record never turns into a title change. Lost at some unrecorded point before Wrestle Insanity, where Notorious is the reigning champion.

title: ucwf-intercontinental
label: “QBz Finest” Blaze

won.source: Wins the title from Notorious at Wrestle Insanity 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/wrestle-insanity-2003.html).

how: Wins the title from Notorious at Wrestle Insanity with the Special Delivery. Lost at some unrecorded point before Resurrection, where “The Reality” A.J. Simmons is the reigning champion.

title: ucwf-intercontinental
label: Rich Bitch

won.source: Wins the title from “The Reality” A.J. Simmons at Resurrection 2003 (promotions/ucwf/archive/resurrection-2003.html).

how: Wins the title from “The Reality” A.J. Simmons at Resurrection with the Bank Rupt — the last title change the surviving record shows for this belt.

title: ucwf-intercontinental
label: Crash Paradise

won.source: Already UCWF Intercontinental Champion by the held record's start.

how: Already champion entering Immortality 2002, accompanied by valet Makayla Royal; loses the title to Scorpion, who finishes with a cross torn off a church wall.

title: ucwf-intercontinental
label: Notorious
how: Already champion entering Wrestle Insanity, where he loses the title to “QBz Finest” Blaze and then jumps him afterward with a chair, earning a suspension from Mumrat.

title: ucwf-intercontinental
label: “The Reality” A.J. Simmons
how: Already champion entering Resurrection, where he loses the title to Rich Bitch, tapping to the Bank Rupt.

title: ucwf-extreme
label: Wes Easton

won.source: Wins the title from Blaze in a Thumbtacks Match at Fury 2002-09-08 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2002-09-08.html).

how: Wins the title from Blaze in a Thumbtacks Match at Fury 2002-09-08 with the Easton Bomb. Lost at some unrecorded point before Wrestle Insanity, where Flashing Thunder is the reigning champion.

title: ucwf-extreme
label: Bryon Wade Osbourne

won.source: Wins the title from Kevin Murray in a Deathmatch on his own UCWF debut, Fury 2003-06-20 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2003-06-20.html).

how: Wins the title from Kevin Murray on his own UCWF debut at Fury 2003-06-20, then retains it at Breakout in a Barbwire Beat Down declared a draw against Sean Johnson after Flashing Thunder is eliminated mid-match — the last the surviving record shows of this belt.

title: ucwf-extreme
label: Blaze

won.source: Already UCWF Extreme Champion by the held record's start.

how: Already champion entering Immortality 2002, where he retains in a three-way over Brax and Bobby Linken, tapping out Brax. Loses the title to Wes Easton in a Thumbtacks Match at Fury 2002-09-08.

title: ucwf-extreme
label: Flashing Thunder
how: Already champion entering Wrestle Insanity, where he retains in a Flaming Hell In A Cell against The Fox declared a draw. Lost at some unrecorded point before Fury 2003-06-20, where Kevin Murray is the outgoing champion.

title: ucwf-extreme
label: Kevin Murray
how: Loses the title in a Deathmatch to a debuting Bryon Wade Osbourne at Fury 2003-06-20.

title: ucwf-hardcore
label: Mr. Wacko

won.source: Wins the title from The Fox at Immortality 2002 (promotions/ucwf/archive/immortality-2002.html).

how: Wins the title from The Fox at Immortality 2002 and retains it days later at Fury 2002-09-08 in a fatal four-way over Crazy Hayze, Bobby Linken and Crusher — the last the surviving record shows of this belt.

title: ucwf-hardcore
label: The Fox

won.source: Already UCWF Hardcore Champion by the held record's start.

how: Already champion entering Immortality 2002, where he loses the title to Mr. Wacko off a backslide in a three-way with CM2.

title: ucwf-vamped
label: The Fox

won.source: Wins the title from The Krazy Kid at Resurrection 2003 with “Outfoxing The Fox” (promotions/ucwf/archive/resurrection-2003.html).

how: Wins the title from The Krazy Kid at Resurrection with “Outfoxing The Fox.” Loses it to “Prime Time” The Vine at Fury 2003-06-20.

title: ucwf-vamped
label: “Prime Time” The Vine

won.source: Wins the title from The Fox with the Vine Bomb at Fury 2003-06-20 (promotions/ucwf/archive/fury-2003-06-20.html).

how: Wins the title from The Fox with the Vine Bomb at Fury 2003-06-20, then retains it at Breakout against Santa Claus, billed as having “just won the title last week” — the last the surviving record shows of this belt.

title: ucwf-vamped
label: The Krazy Kid

won.source: Already UCWF Vamped Champion the belt's first appearance in the surviving record, at Wrestle Insanity 2003; absent from both of the fed's own 2002 shows.

how: Already champion entering Wrestle Insanity, where he retains with the Krazy Cutter over CM2. Loses the title to The Fox at Resurrection.
